manual.storage_barrels.line2: {0}Wooden Barrels are simple containers that can store up to 12 buckets of liquid, but not gasses or hot fluids.{1}
manual.storage_barrels.line3: Right-clicking the vertical sides of the barrel with the Engineer's Hammer will configure them.{0}
manual.storage_barrels.line4: {0}Metal Barrels are identical to their wooden counterparts, other than the material of their construction.{1}
manual.storage_barrels.line5: Metal barrels may store hot fluids as well as gasses, and their automatic output can be disabled by a redstone signal.
